table.search: Search tag, name, plate or driver

tip.title: Know who has what.
tip.description: Check equipment out to a driver when it leaves the depot and back in when it returns, so every scanner, bag and vehicle has an owner.

form.tipDescription: Use the tag printed on the asset so it can be found by scanning or searching. Plate, VIN and road tax are asked for motorcycles and vans only.
form.editTipDescription: Set its condition to decommissioned. Check it in first if a driver has it; its history stays.

details.decommissionedNote: It can't be checked out or serviced. Its history stays.
details.tipDescription: Log every service with its next due date, so the vehicle is flagged before it's due.

checkOut.title: Check out {{name}}
checkOut.description: Hand it to a driver. It stays with them until it's checked back in.
checkOut.noDrivers: No drivers to choose from. Onboard one in Drivers first.

checkIn.title: Check in {{name}}
checkIn.description: Take it back from {{driver}} into the depot.

maintenance.title: Log a service for {{name}}
maintenance.description: A service, repair or inspection. Set the condition it's in afterwards.

errors.invalidTag: Use 2–64 letters, digits, or dashes, e.g. AST-009.
errors.invalidAmount: Enter an amount with up to 2 decimals, e.g. 85.00.
errors.dueBeforeService: Pick a date after the service.
errors.tagTaken: This asset tag is already used.
errors.checkedOut: A driver has this asset. Check it in before decommissioning it.
errors.alreadyCheckedOut: Someone checked this asset out first.
errors.notCheckedOut: This asset was already checked in.
errors.notFound: This asset doesn't exist in this company.
